title.en: Suterare Kisaki - Medetaku Rien ga Seiritsu Shita no de Dete Ittara, Ryuukoku no Outaishi kara no Dekiai ga Matteimashita

altTitles.ja: 捨てられた妃 めでたく離縁が成立したので出ていったら、竜国の王太子からの溺愛が待っていました

altTitles.en: The Abandoned Queen - Luckily, My Divorce was Finalized. Once I Left, I Found the Crown Prince of Dragonia Waiting for Me

description.en:
Rosaria, a talented young woman skilled in crafting magical tools, was chosen by royal decree to marry Crown Prince Wilbert—an acknowledgment of her abilities and her quiet devotion to the kingdom and its people.But despite everything she gave, all she received was neglect. One day, her husband told her coldly: “I have no intention of ever loving you.”
Thus passed six years of a cold, emotionless marriage, during which she became known as “the wife no one loved.”

But when Wilbert’s mistress became pregnant, Rosaria’s role ended abruptly—she was heartlessly cast aside through divorce. Yet, the divorce wasn’t a curse—it was the freedom she had long been waiting for.
With a gentle smile and a heart as light as a feather, Rosaria decided to start over—accompanied by her faithful head servant, Aris, who had supported her in silence for all those years. At his suggestion, they journeyed together to his homeland, a place she had only read about in old books: The Kingdom of Dragons—Lacteus. In this land, where dragons take human form and believe in the sacred bond of soulmates—one person destined to be your eternal partner—Rosaria discovers that Aris, the quiet companion by her side, is not only a powerful dragon…but may be her true fated mate.Yet behind his warm gaze lie secrets still hidden.

From a discarded wife to a free woman in a kingdom of myths,
this is the story of a woman’s rise from rejection to a love more powerful than she ever dreamed of.
